Red rule: no red #D92F2B anywhere. Soft upper-left illumination reveals shallow paper layers, without any room backdrop.

These coordinates are instructions; never draw guides or labels.

Strict exclusions: no text, letters, numerals, pseudo-writing, logos, watermarks, signatures, captions, speech bubbles, arrows, annotation marks, motion lines, impact bursts, sparkles or drawn effects. No additional people, props, modern devices, brands, blood, wounds or weapons. Original fictional characters only. Character-sheet views are intact figures, never separated body parts, puppet rigs or assembly diagrams.

Image 2 is an approved paper scene used ONLY for physical paper layer material and soft upper-left illumination. Do not copy image 2's cast, anatomy, setting, layout or scene colors; the explicit six-color palette governs this new Mama sheet.
Layout priority: The stricter y=200..700 bounds override any wider bounds; y=0..199 and y=701..1023 must be uninterrupted empty cream paper, with no art or shadows. The entire figures are only about 450 pixels tall on the 1024-pixel-tall canvas. Keep all four depictions as a SMALL compact row like image 1, with generous gaps. Three equally scaled views depict ONE SAME ADULT woman with mature adult body proportions and a clearly 38-year-old face; the portrait is a conventional connected head and shoulders. Hair clip stays at its actual REAR position in every view, naturally visible only where the angle allows; never relocate it to the temple or forehead to make it visible.
